method_specification.domain_committed.reason: The committed application is single-CpG methylation imputation for ENCODE HepG2 WGBS on human chromosome 1. It is distinct from all excluded benchmarks and the climate proof of concept.

Segments are separated only where the kernel certifies zero cross-covariance. This is a documented specialization within the exact-GP framework, supported by a full-scale reference-pipeline equivalence record.

method_specification.kernel_adaptation_s.reason: The paper specifies the bp/index interpolation, Wendland polynomial, support radius, density covariate, amplitude field, mean, and noise construction. scale_floor.full_scale_achieved.reason: The runtime training size is 2,123,184, exactly the larger size committed in the plan and above the 500,000-point floor. The stored prepared dataset independently contains that many non-test sites.

scale_floor.solve_at_full_scale.reason: Every production likelihood evaluation factors and solves all certified independent segments covering the entire training set and sums their log determinants. kernel_contribution.kernel_differs_from_.reason: The implementation adds a learned interpolation between physical and catalog-index distance, a sequence-density amplitude field, and a monotone support certificate. These change covariance and scheduling structure beyond retuning a stock Wendland bandwidth, although they use established kernel-composition principles.

kernel_contribution.existing_kernel_inad.reason: On the identical full-scale training and test sets, stationary Wendland has RMSE 0.24834 and CRPS 0.13677 versus 0.24484 and 0.13413 for the adaptation. Island RMSE improves from 0.17030 to 0.14917. The reference also requires bandwidth 340 versus 51. These establish inadequacy of the tested references, without proving inadequacy of every possible paper-family parameterization.

kernel_contribution.adaptation_motivated.reason: The construction links local CpG density to physical correlation reach, signal variation, and computational support, while read depth motivates heteroscedastic observation variance. These are specific properties of the methylation task.

kernel_contribution.domain_warrants_new_.reason: Although indexed along a chromosome, the data have substantial density-dependent nonstationarity and read-depth heteroscedasticity. Compartment-specific errors and the large bandwidth difference between metrics show that this is not merely a smoothly stationary one-dimensional interpolation problem.

insight_contribution.insight_present.reason: The work offers substantive findings beyond metric improvement: fitted correlations favor CpG-index distance, predictability varies by genomic compartment, and high-depth replicate differences are much smaller than the fitted site-level residual variance. These are linked to chains and replicate analyses.

insight_contribution.insight_grounded_in.reason: The fitted metric, compartment differences, and replicate-variance calculations are directly supported. Stronger conclusions—that any neighborhood method faces the inferred accuracy floor and that sequencing budget should favor breadth—are not established by these single-model observational analyses. The sharply quantified posterior interpretation is also limited by continuing noise-parameter drift and differing chromosome-21 chains.

comparison_quality.reproduction_faithful.reason: The submission exercises the required MNIST dataset at 60,000/10,000 scale with three seeds, high-dimensional distances, parallel sparse assembly, and reference solvers. However, Brier 0.0790 ± 0.0021 misses the stated upper tolerance of 0.024, and the production reproduction uses kW alone rather than the paper's kWkd. The additional density diagnostic reaches only 0.0310. This provides partial machinery evidence, not a successful reproduction.

comparison_quality.test_set_held_out_pro.reason: The main test set contains 15,000 sites, exceeding min(1% of 2,123,184, 10,000)=10,000. comparison_quality.baseline_genuine_effo.reason: The mandatory at-least-one baseline requirement is supported by SVGP: an eight-configuration validation grid varies inducing count, features, and likelihood, followed by three selected-configuration runs on all 2,123,184 training sites. comparison_quality.quality_metric_compet.reason: Against the executed approximate baselines, the advantage is much larger than seed variation: adapted RMSE/CRPS are 0.24484/0.13413, versus SVGP 0.38043 ± 0.00111/0.22317 ± 0.00090 and VNNGP 0.42221 ± 0.00059/0.24848 ± 0.00033. Saved predictions reproduce these comparisons on identical test rows.

metric_reporting.baseline_metrics_recomp.reason: The stationary and convolution reference kernels were independently scored for RMSE, Gaussian CRPS, and all 19 coverage levels using their own saved predictions. They are compared directly with the adapted kernel.

mechanism_analysis.subsection_present.reason: The Analysis contains an explicit mechanism subsection.

mechanism_analysis.mechanism_explains_ke.reason: The analysis connects the warp to density-dependent physical reach and nearly constant support in site count. It explains why a global bp radius or coarse coordinate fields miss the tested fine-scale structure, and uses the observation-model ablation to distinguish kernel gains from noise-model gains.

failure_analysis.subsection_present.reason: An explicit Failure modes and limitations subsection appears in the Analysis.

failure_analysis.patterns_identified.reason: Specific supported patterns include island overcoverage, larger open-sea residuals, continuing noise-parameter drift, and the expensive bandwidths of coordinate-based references. The paper also identifies the predicted compartment-antisymmetric calibration failure that did not occur.

failure_analysis.patterns_explained_cohe.reason: The main explanations follow the model structure: a compartment-independent nugget produces overly wide island intervals; read-depth floors affect calibration; and broader bp support increases factorization cost. These explanations agree with the logged breakdowns and traces, although they do not establish universal limits for other models.

scaling_analysis.subsection_present.reason: The Analysis explicitly discusses bandwidth, the 768-site support budget, zero budget rejections, and the greater computational cost of the stationary and convolution kernels.

scaling_analysis.sparsity_scaling_discus.reason: The paper derives O(Nb) assembly/storage and O(Nb²) banded factorization, explains the support-budget boundary, and connects them to executed chromosome-scale computations. originality_and_literature.contribution_.reason: The domain-specific metric interpolation, certified scheduling, chromosome-scale execution, and replicate analysis add substantive scientific content. originality_and_literature.literature_en.reason: The paper engages beyond gp2Scale with methylation smoothing and imputation, local CpG topology and maintenance dynamics, covariance modeling, and variational GP methods. originality_and_literature.spec_independ.reason: The title, motivation, mathematical construction, and scientific discussion center on methylation geometry and uncertainty.
